dimensions.assessment: Affects eligible nonprofit organizations applying for DHS security grants, security personnel, off-duty police officers, and grant administrative staff.
dimensions.evidence: The Nonprofit Security Grant Program of the Department of Homeland Security... including the hiring of onsite security personnel... Hiring of off-duty police officers.

dimensions.assessment: Expands and clarifies permissible expenses under an existing grant program without altering total funding amounts.
dimensions.evidence: Hiring personnel to apply for funding under this section, except that such expenses may not exceed 5 percent of the amount of the grant.

dimensions.assessment: Does not alter overall grant funding or authorize new appropriations, restricting application personnel costs to 5 percent of grant amounts.
dimensions.evidence: Hiring personnel to apply for funding under this section, except that such expenses may not exceed 5 percent of the amount of the grant.

dimensions.assessment: Makes narrow clarifying amendments to Section 2009(c)(1) of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 regarding the Nonprofit Security Grant Program.
dimensions.evidence: Section 2009(c)(1) of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (6 U.S.C. 609a(c)(1)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Provides permanent statutory clarification for the administration of the DHS Nonprofit Security Grant Program.

importance_detail.rationale: The Safe Spaces for All Act clarifies allowable uses under the Department of Homeland Security's Nonprofit Security Grant Program to explicitly include hiring onsite security personnel, off-duty police officers, and grant application personnel.
